reasoning: The stored package passes all 33 tests. Changing only this owner's reducer initial value from 0 to 1 makes its returned promise reject at `expect(sum).toBe(30)` with 31, and the whole Jest command exits 1; restoration passes again. The dot-leading `.then` follows the owner call on the next line; its rejection handler refuses static assertion collection, but a failing fulfilment assertion still rejects the returned promise. RIPR-SPEC-0246 rule 4 and #9354 tie this refused callback to the changed owner, so the analyzer abstains as `static_unknown` (`limited`) rather than reporting an actionable gap. This row records runtime discrimination independently of that static abstention.
